title: Felt WASM code generator: typed AST → .wasm binary
description: Generate WASM binary from verified AST using wasm-encoder crate, targeting WASM GC (WebAssembly 3.0). All collections and records use GC struct/array types (struct.new, array.new, struct.get, array.get). Options use nullable refs (ref.null, ref.is_null). Linear memory used ONLY for JSON I/O buffers. Emit GC type definitions in TypeSection. Emit alloc/dealloc for JSON buffer only. Emit extension functions as WASM exports. Include minimal JSON serde runtime that deserializes into GC structs and serializes from GC structs. Target: under 30KB for typical extensions (smaller than pre-GC since no allocator). Dependencies: wasm-encoder. Requires wasmtime 27+ or Chrome/Firefox for execution.
